buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.

3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Bidder must upload signed and stamped Compliance of Technical specification s uploaded in "Buyer Specification Document" for technical evaluation purpose, e lse offer will be liable for rejection. Bids will be evaluated on the basis of buyer a dded specific terms and conditions only. 2) Pre Dispatch Inspection: Pre dispatch inspection shall be carried out at supplie r’s site. The supplier has to demonstrate the machine along with the prove out o f components. 3) Delivery Period : Material to be supplied within 29 Months from the date of PO placement. 4) Installation and Commissioning: The commissioning shall be completed by the supplier at HAL within 120 days after receiving go ahead from HAL on receipt of t he material at HAL site. 5) Training: The supplier has to provide Training to 2 engineers free of cost at th eir works for 1 week in the following areas- (i) Machine operation (ii) CNC programming (iii) Mechanical Maintenance (iv) Electrical CNC Maintenance (v) CNC Control System Further during commissioning at HAL works the suppliers engineer should provid e three days training on machine operation and maintenance. 7) Warranty: Entire machine inclusive of all systems/accessories/should be warra nted for period of 1 year from the date of installation commissioning against all the design, material or manufacturing defects. 8) SD: Successful vendor has to submit security deposit equivalent to 5% amount of total PO value (excluding taxes) within 15 days after placement of GeM Contra ct.The EMD SD, PBG, shall bear no interest. Security deposit can be submitted by the way of demand draft ,bank guarantee (including e-bank guarantee) in a pres cribed format of HAL. Which shall be valid up to 60 days after the completion of contract period/last supply. In case the supply order /contract is not executed to the entire satisfaction of HAL, the security deposit will be forfeited. 9) Performance Bank Guarantee: PBG to be provided for 5% of Contract Value (Ex

cluding GST) valid for 14 months from the date of final acceptance at HAL site. F urther (i) Bank Guarantee to be issued on Non Judicial Stamp Paper for such Value as ap plicable in the place of issue of BG as per the applicable Stamp Act in the State. (ii) The Stamp Paper for issuing of BG should be purchased by the Vendor in the following manner: - First Party in the Stamp Paper: “In the Name of the Bank iss uing the BG”., Second Party in the Stamp Paper : “In the Name of the Beneficiary under the BG i.e. Hindustan Aeronautics Limited”. (iii) Purchaser of Stamp Paper: “In the Name of the Vendor on whose behalf the BG is issued”. 10) EMD : EMD Amount Rs 10,00000.00 to be submitted before Due date, please i nclude EMD submission proof details in Technical bid submission part. Upload th e EMD Document proof in GeM. EMD SD amount where applicable can be paid thr ough SBI Collect portal in online mode to Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd, Nasik Divisi on. The scanned image of deposit copy of earnest money deposit / SD, through S BI Collect, to be uploaded along with the Technical bid. Steps for Payment for onl ine EMD/SD / Tender fee through SBI collect are as follow for reference please. STEP-1 Login to https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect STEP-2 Click on select category as “PSU-Public Sector Undertaking” STEP-3 Filter by State as “Maharashtra “in the drop down menu. There after sele ct “PSU-Public Sector Undertaking” name as Hindustan Aeronautics Limited and Click. STEP-4 Select Payment Category as “RECEIPT FROM SUPPLIER/ VENDORS/ CONTR ACTORS / OTHERS” and Fill-up the respective information correctly and Select pu rpose of Transfer as “EMD/ Security Deposit / Tender fee ( As applicable) , Select “ Nature of Supplier” as applicable . Fill details correctly and Click “Submit”. STEP-5 If all details entered are correctly populated, click “NEXT” to proceed. Ve rify the payment Details,Click “Next” to proceed. STEP-6 Make payment as per your convenience. (Options avail able are payment of fees through Net Banking / Card Payments/ Other Payment Modes). STEP-7 Print Receipt and upload in the technical bid of portal. 11) Bidder should upload sign and stamp MII certificate as performat attached at buyer specific ATC. 12) If bidder is MSME, then bidder must confirm following category: (a)Women ( Yes / No), and (b) SC / ST (Yes/No) 13) For MSMEs & Start-ups, 15% (of the basic price) interest free Advance shall b

e payable against BG of equivalent amount, balance 85% shall be paid within 30 days of receipt and acceptance at our stores. In case 15% Advance is not sought by the vendor, 100% payment shall be made within 30 days of receipt and accept ance at our stores. PBG Submission: Vendor shall furnish a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) (including e-Bank Gurantee) as per HAL's format for 10% of the order value (to be calculated only on basic cost excluding taxes and duties if such details are furnished separately in the bid submitted) valid up to end of warranty period from a scheduled bank in India/Bank of On international repute ( for foreign vendor) from the date of acceptance/commissioning or otherwise equivalent amou nt shall be retained till completion of warranty period and other obligation of purchase order/C ontract. Performance security can also be furnished in the form of Demand Draft or retention of equiva lent amount till completion of warranty period. . 6.
